page: Microsoft Azure ND96amsr_A100_v4 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the NDAMSv4_A100 family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 1800.0 GB of system memory, providing 18.75 GB of RAM per core, which positions it as a memory-intensive configuration.

This server integrates eight GPUs and includes 10650 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is premium storage capable and supports Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) networking. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given the integration of eight GPUs, 1800.0 GB of RAM, and over 10 TB of local NVMe SSD storage, this server represents a high-density hardware class. The qualitative cost profile reflects its specialized resource allocation for large-scale parallel processing. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training, large-scale GPU-accelerated simulations, memory-intensive database operations, and high-throughput data analysis.
